## Network Security  
### Perimeter Security  
**Firewall:**
- Stateful inspection firewall
- Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs
- Egress: Restricted outbound (whitelist-based)
- Rules logged and monitored  
**DDoS Protection:**
- AWS Shield (managed DDoS protection)
- Rate limiting on APIs
- Anomalous traffic detection
- Traffic rerouting if DDoS detected  
**Intrusion Detection/Prevention:**
- Network-based IDS (Snort-like rules)
- Host-based IDS on critical systems
- Automated response (block malicious IPs)

raw_entities.name: Network Security Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing network security controls including firewall configuration, DDoS protection, and intrusion detection/prevention mechanisms. Establishes requirements for perimeter security, traffic monitoring, and automated threat response.

raw_entities.name: Stateful Firewall Inspection Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requirement to implement stateful inspection firewall as the primary perimeter security control. Firewall must restrict ingress to HTTPS (Port 443) only for public APIs and enforce whitelist-based egress restrictions.
context: Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs

raw_entities.name: Firewall Rule Logging and Monitoring Obligation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to log and monitor all firewall rules to maintain audit trail and detect policy violations or suspicious patterns.

raw_entities.name: DDoS Protection Implementation Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requirement to implement managed DDoS protection using AWS Shield, rate limiting on APIs, anomalous traffic detection, and automated traffic rerouting in response to detected DDoS attacks.

raw_entities.name: Intrusion Detection and Prevention System Deployment
raw_entities.description: Requirement to deploy both network-based and host-based intrusion detection systems with automated response capabilities to block malicious IP addresses.

raw_entities.name: Stateful Inspection Firewall
raw_entities.description: Perimeter security control implementing stateful packet inspection with port-based ingress restrictions (HTTPS only) and whitelist-based egress filtering. All firewall rules are logged and monitored.
context: Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs

raw_entities.name: AWS Shield DDoS Protection
raw_entities.description: Managed DDoS protection service providing rate limiting on APIs, anomalous traffic detection, and automated traffic rerouting to mitigate distributed denial-of-service attacks.

raw_entities.name: Network-Based Intrusion Detection System
raw_entities.description: Network-based intrusion detection system using Snort-like rules to identify and alert on suspicious network traffic patterns and potential attacks.

raw_entities.name: Host-Based Intrusion Detection System
raw_entities.description: Host-based intrusion detection system deployed on critical systems to monitor system-level activities and detect unauthorized access or malicious behavior.

raw_entities.name: Automated Malicious IP Blocking
raw_entities.description: Automated response mechanism that blocks malicious IP addresses detected by intrusion detection systems to prevent ongoing attacks.

raw_entities.name: Distributed Denial of Service Attack
raw_entities.description: Risk of service disruption through coordinated high-volume traffic attacks targeting network infrastructure and APIs. Mitigated through rate limiting, traffic detection, and rerouting mechanisms.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Network Access
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized access to network resources and critical systems through exploitation of vulnerabilities or malicious network activity. Addressed through firewall controls, intrusion detection, and automated blocking.
